mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with a 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a concurrent increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening that reduces recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 6.0 and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and GDPC1 increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rising consumer price index signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
